title: 第5章 突破材料第6章 全员震撼
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
一席话，罗家众人全都傻了。
如果换其他人说这种话，他们一定认为这人是疯了。
可是刚刚，在亲眼见识到罗天的恐怖之后，他们都明白，罗天说的是真的。
“罗天，你需要什么资源突破聚气？家族会全力帮助你！”
大长老发话。
开什么玩笑？
聚气之后，罗家就多了一个堪比归墟的强者！
那是什么概念？
那意味着，在夜风国内，罗家也是一流势力了！
到时候罗家的安全自不必说，就连各种资源，也会十倍、百倍的增加！
“嗯，我的确有些东西，得请家族费心！”
说话间，罗天取出一张清单来，递给罗峰。
“这是我聚气需要的材料！”
罗天说道。
武道修为，小境界突破，只需要消耗灵气。
至于大境界突破，都需要不少材料辅助才能完成。
而且，越是强者突破，需要的材料越复杂，越珍贵。
没办法，修炼就是一个烧钱的事情。
而罗天这份清单，正是从《天道经》上得来的。
罗峰盯着清单看了许久，又将之转给大长老。

后者看罢，眉头紧皱。
“这清单之中，其他东西都还好办，但有几种材料，家族没有……不，怕是整个边北城都找不到。”
他说道。
“哦？哪几样材料？”
罗天问道。
大长老用手指圈道：“第一是这神兽之血，第二个是先天灵晶，第三是这千年钟乳……这三种材料，家族也无能为力，但其他东西，倒是有办法弄到。”
罗天眉头一皱，道：“这样么？”
这三种材料，都是不可替换的东西，真要是缺了这东西，后续修炼肯定要出麻烦。
就在这时，罗家四长老忽然开口道：“神兽之血，我倒是有些消息。”
“哦？”
罗天看向他。
四长老道：“传闻之中，天荡山脉内，有一头妖兽，乃是神兽后裔，不知道用他的血可不可以？”
罗天顿时喜道：“没有问题，只要有神兽血脉，哪怕稀薄一点，也可以！”
四长老迟疑道：“可是天荡山脉，是妖兽的地盘，人类的话，就算是御空境强者进去，都是九死一生。”
罗天笑道：“这个好说，我亲自走一趟！”
众人纷纷点头。
罗天的实力，可比御空境强多了。
content_en:
After a few words, everyone in the Luo family was stunned.
If anyone else had said this, they would have thought he was crazy.
But just now, after seeing Luo Tian's terror with their own eyes, they all understood that what Luo Tian said was true.
"Luo Tian, what resources do you need to break through the energy gathering? The family will do its best to help you!"
The great elder spoke.
Are you kidding me?
After gathering Qi, the Luo family has a strong man comparable to Guixu!
What is that concept?
That means that the Luo family is also a first-rate force in Ye Feng's country!
By then, not to mention the safety of the Luo family, even various resources will increase tenfold or a hundredfold!
"Well, I do have something that I need to ask the family to take care of!"
While talking, Luo Tian took out a list and handed it to Luo Feng.
"This is the material I need to gather energy!"
Luo Tian said.
Martial arts cultivation and small realm breakthroughs only require the consumption of spiritual energy.
As for big realm breakthroughs, it requires a lot of material assistance to complete.
Moreover, the stronger a person breaks through, the more complex and precious the materials required.
There is no way, cultivation is a money-burning thing.
Luo Tian got this list from the "Tiandao Jing".
Luo Feng stared at the list for a long time and then forwarded it to the Great Elder.
The latter looked at it and frowned.
"Everything else in this list is easy to handle, but there are a few materials that the family doesn't have... No, I'm afraid I won't be able to find them in the entire Bianbei City."
he said.
"Oh? Which materials?"
Luo Tian asked.
The great elder circled his fingers and said: "The first is the blood of the divine beast, the second is the innate spiritual crystal, and the third is the thousand-year stalactite... There is nothing the family can do about these three materials, but there are ways to get other things."
Luo Tian frowned and said, "Is that so?"
These three materials are irreplaceable. If they are missing, there will definitely be trouble in subsequent cultivation.
At this moment, the fourth elder of the Luo family suddenly said: "I have some news about the blood of the divine beast."
"Oh?"
Luo Tian looked at him.
The fourth elder said: "There are rumors that there is a monster beast in the Tiandang Mountains. It is the descendant of the divine beast. I wonder if I can use his blood?"
Luo Tian immediately said happily: "No problem, as long as you have the blood of the divine beast, even if it is a little thinner, it will be fine!"
The fourth elder hesitated and said: "But the Tiandang Mountains are the territory of monsters. For humans, even if they are strong in the air control realm, they will have a narrow escape from death."
Luo Tian smiled and said: "This is easy to say, I will go there myself!"
Everyone nodded.
Luo Tian's strength is much stronger than that of the Sky Control Realm.
